feeds.title: The Cardiovascular Care Group Blog » Aneurysm
feeds.description: The Cardiovascular Care Group blog offers articles related to arterial health, aneurysms, and more. New Jersey's largest Vascular Surgery group is dedicated solely to the diagnosis and management of diseases of the arteries and veins. The Cardiovascular Care Group provides the highest quality care using the newest technologies in the setting of years of experience with outstanding results.

feeds.title: Neurosurgery Blog » Aneurysm
feeds.description: In the following section of Neurosurgery Blog, you can find news, stories, and articles about aneurysms. Neurosurgery Blog is a daily bibliographic review of the Neurosurgery Department. One can find more about intracranial-aneurysm, neurosurgery, hydrocephalus, and more.

feeds.title: Heidi's Brain Blog
feeds.description: If you are reading this because you are a survivor, have lost a loved one, or have recently been diagnosed with a brain aneurysm, I hope you find this blog comforting, informative, educational, honest, and humorous even if I get sarcastic at times. Hi! I am an Aneurysm Survivor, Writing this blog has not only been therapeutic for me over the years but I have been told it has helped a few people since I started it in 2006.

feeds.title: Rebel EM » Abdominal Aortic Aneurysm
feeds.description: Read news, stories, and articles on Abdominal Aortic Aneurysms in the following segment of REBEL EM. REBEL EM stands for Rational Evidence Based Evaluation of Literature in Emergency Medicine. We cover a myriad of topics, primarily focusing on evidence-based clinical topics at its core, evidence-based medicine incorporates clinical judgment, relevant scientific evidence, and patient values/preferences.

feeds.title: The Bee Foundation Blog
feeds.description: Explore the research on 'Brain Aneurysm ' done by The Bee Foundation and be updated on Brain Aneurysm Awareness. The mission of The Bee Foundation is to raise awareness of brain aneurysms and increase funding for innovative research that saves lives. Our community, anchored by grant recipients and the Bee Hive network, is committed to advancing brain aneurysm research.

feeds.title: Brain Aneurysm Foundation
feeds.description: Brain Aneurysm Foundation's blog posts important updates and stories for our community about brain aneurysms and patient stories. The Brain Aneurysm Foundation aspires toward a life without death or disabilities caused by brain aneurysm ruptures. The foundation wants to keep families and communities whole and keep people in the workforce.
